ownRead.description: An open downstream extension, distinct from the minimal locked definitions.
ownRead.researchEdition: RRG v0.3.1 — relation to existing work, 2026-10-07
ownRead.statement:
## 11. Background / possibility-space status

The idea that global cosmological/environmental conditions change which resonant geometries are accessible is an **extension compatible with the core**, not part of the minimal definition.
ownRead.plainLanguage: Can an existing organization change which later organizations its surroundings support? [Bacterial changes to acidity](/references/#BIB-0089) make one environmental effect concrete. The source's broader extension asks how such effects connect across stages, including the origin of units. This remains a research proposal beyond the minimal definitions.
ownRead.scope: An open downstream extension, distinct from the minimal locked definitions.
ownRead.limits: Environmental feedback in a specified system does not establish repeated physical construction or a universal increase in complexity. The proposed background recursion is an extension beyond the minimal core.
